description: Deterministic SanMar SOAP and PromoStandards integration tools.

tools.name: sanmar_search_products
tools.summary: Look up SanMar products by style code (catalog discovery).

tools.name: sanmar_check_inventory
tools.summary: Check live SanMar inventory for a single style/color/size.

color.description: SanMar mainframe color code preferred. If a marketing color name is passed and auto_resolve_color is true, the tool resolves it via the SDL CSV on the FTP server and retries automatically.

ftp_credentials.description: Used only when auto-resolving the mainframe color falls back to the SDL FTP file.

auto_resolve_color.description: Default true. On API error or empty response, fetch the SDL CSV and retry once with the resolved mainframe color.

output.notes: SanMar's inventory endpoint returns a list of warehouse quantities; total_available is the maximum single-warehouse value (matching upstream availability semantics in the reference implementation).

tools.name: sanmar_get_pricing
tools.summary: Pull customer-specific (myPrice) and tier pricing for one or more style/color/size lines.

ftp_credentials.description: Used only when auto-resolving missing lines via the SDL FTP file.

auto_resolve_color.description: Default true. If the response is missing some lines (a signal that a marketing color name was used), fetch the SDL CSV and retry the missing lines with their mainframe colors.

tools.name: sanmar_validate_cart
tools.summary: Run a SanMar pre-submit (getPreSubmitInfo) check against a draft PO without committing it. Surfaces inventory and validation errors per line.

tools.name: sanmar_create_purchase_order
tools.summary: Submit a SanMar purchase order via SOAP. EXTERNAL WRITE.
tools.preflight_required: sanmar_validate_cart and sanmar_get_pricing should be called first to enrich each line with inventoryKey and sizeIndex.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually transmit. Otherwise the tool returns a dry-run preview.

tools.name: sanmar_check_order_status
tools.summary: Fetch SanMar's sales-order number for a previously submitted PO via the OrderShipmentNotification PromoStandards service.

po_number.description: Customer-side PO reference (poNum used at submit time).

tools.name: sanmar_get_tracking
tools.summary: Return tracking numbers and normalized carriers for a SanMar PO.

tools.name: sanmar_parse_po_pdf
tools.summary: Extract a draft purchase order (po_number, ship_to, lines) from a PDF that the user uploads. The agent must show the parsed values to the user for approval before submitting.

pdf_path.description: Filesystem path to the PDF. Provide either pdf_path OR pdf_bytes.

pdf_bytes.description: Raw PDF content. Provide either pdf_path OR pdf_bytes.

output.notes: The 'draft_for_submit' field is a ready-to-pass purchase_order dict for sanmar_create_purchase_order, populated only when po_number and at least one line are present. Always confirm with the user before submitting.

tools.name: sanmar_lookup_mainframe_color
tools.summary: Resolve a marketing color name (e.g. 'Athletic Heather') to SanMar's mainframe color code (e.g. 'ATHHTHR') via the SDL CSV on SanMar's SFTP server. Use this when inventory or pricing queries fail with an invalid-color error.

color.description: Marketing color name as shown in the catalog or PO.

size.description: Optional size filter to disambiguate multi-size matches.

ftp_credentials.description: Optional. Defaults to SANMAR_FTP_USERNAME / SANMAR_FTP_PASSWORD env vars.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the local cache and re-download the SDL CSV. Default false.

output.notes: status is one of 'matched' | 'ambiguous' | 'not_found'. The CSV is cached locally (default /tmp/sme-sanmar-cache) for 24h between fetches.

tools.name: sanmar_cancel_order
tools.summary: Cancel a previously submitted SanMar PO. EXTERNAL WRITE.
tools.stub_reason: SanMar does not expose a public cancel endpoint in the SOAP web services or PromoStandards bindings used by the reference implementation. Cancellation today goes through SanMar customer service. The tool surface is reserved so future vendor support can be added without breaking callers.
